customers_say: Customers find the digital lock to be feature-rich and easy to use, with good installation and service. Moreover, they appreciate its security features, providing a better sense of security, and one customer notes it works well on wooden doors. However, opinions about value for money are mixed, and reliability receives mixed feedback.
